Born to share

Showroom

Our Villiers-le-Bouillet premises are designed to respond as efficiently as possible to our profession’s logistical challenges, but we also wanted to be able to receive our clients with the same degree of efficiency. Our showroom welcomes vets who would like to place their orders directly on-site and more generally all vets who take part in seminars and conferences. Each year, the general meeting allows our many shareholders (over 100 at this time) to visit our showroom. Here you will find various equipment and work instruments, which you can compare and analyse in order to meet your needs as effectively as possible.

Our training courses

Created by and for veterinary surgeons, ALCYON Belux will assist you throughout your career. ALCYON Belux is associated with carefully chosen partners to assist you with your training. These partners may either be directly linked with you at your work or connected by a series of peripheral services allowing you to devote a maximum of time and energy to your passion - your veterinary work!

Please do not hesitate to communicate your needs in terms of company set-up, finances, marketing, etc. ALCYON Belux will always try to find you the training course that suits you best and provides you with the maximum added value.

My tailor-made set-up

Created by and for vets, ALCYON Belux will assist you throughout your career. Setting up constitutes the first stage of a long-term, high-quality partnership. Your Alcyon teams are available for advising and assisting you towards a successful outcome for your project in numerous areas.

Alcyon equipment

ALCYON Belux’ equipment department offers you a range of high-quality medical equipment. Our range is constantly kept up to date and benefits from the most recent technologies available on the market. We visit international trade fairs and are constantly seeking out the most modern equipment and in particular the equipment that is best adapted to your needs and your financial resources.

Thus, ALCYON Belux ensures efficient and speedy after-sales service for you.

We can help you to find funding sources, if that proves necessary. ALCYON Belux is not a mere supplier. We’re your partner!

Who do i need to contact to prepare my surgery and optimise my equipment?

Contact your Advisory Rep, whose details you can find below or get from our call centre.

Your rep will take the time to draw up a list with you of the equipment you really need and will help optimise your budget. Please do not hesitate to contact us to get an offer:

After-sales service

Created by and for vets, ALCYON Belux will assist you throughout your career. Your surgery and your equipment - essential components allowing you to exercise your profession effectively and with peace of mind.

First-line intervention

The Alcyon equipment department will immediately assist you in the event of any problems in order either to find an immediate solution as far as possible or to monitor the intervention of the specialist in question.

ALCYON will follow up on repairs in the maintenance contracts, which we strongly recommend taking out when making your investment.

Follow-up on warranties

In accordance with each supplier’s own conditions, ALCYON Belux can guide you and assist you in order to ensure that the supplier gives you the help you need as quickly as possible and under the best possible conditions. ALCYON Belux can be limited in its actions by a supplier’s specific terms and conditions.

Replacement equipment

Given the range and variety of the equipment made available to you, it is clearly impossible for ALCYON to have replacement equipment permanently available. However, we always do our very best to try to sort you out while your own equipment is unavailable.
